claims.text: The local catalog models the All Nippon Airlines Get in a Jet! 2000 campaign phase 2 source group as one row containing Togepi at source index 207.
Bulbapedia says the ANA Togepi was an Unnumbered Promotional card distributed by All Nippon Airways between September 1 and October 31, 2000 through the Get in a Jet! 2000 campaign.
Bulbapedia says passengers could redeem boarding passes for the card, with stubs affixed to special postcards and mailed to Media Factory no later than November 10, 2000.

PokeBoon's Japanese event page says the Get in a Jet! 2000 campaign required two All Nippon Airways domestic boarding-pass stubs attached to a postcard, with phase 2 covering September 1-October 31, a November 10 deadline, and Togepi as the phase 2 present.
Bulbapedia says the bottom border text on the ANA Togepi reads ANA special 2000 version card.
Bulbapedia credits the ANA Togepi artwork to Ryuta Kusumi and CR CG gangs.
PokeBoon lists the ANA Togepi illustrator as Naoyo Kimura, creating a source-surface conflict with Bulbapedia's Ryuta Kusumi / CR CG gangs credit.
Bulbapedia identifies the ANA Togepi as トゲピー Togepi, a Colorless-type Basic Pokemon card with 40 HP and the Run Around attack.

As judged collector texture, ANA Get in a Jet! 2000 Togepi matters because the card's softness sits inside a hard route: an airline flight, boarding-pass stubs, a postcard, a deadline, and a campaign border all have to line up before the catalog identity makes sense.

narrative.human_title: ANA Get in a Jet! 2000 Togepi: the soft card with a hard route
narrative.why_it_matters: The phase 2 ANA Togepi has a wonderful tension: the card is tiny, gentle, almost shy, but its identity is all route discipline. You need the September-October domestic-flight window, the two boarding-pass stubs, the special postcard, the Media Factory deadline, and the ANA special 2000 border text before the word Togepi is enough. That is exactly why this belongs in the catalog: the story is not just the character, it is the assembly that let the character arrive.

narrative.human_title: Togepi: the soft card with a receipt trail
narrative.why_it_matters: Togepi is the right kind of fragile for this route. On the surface, it is a small Colorless baby Pokemon with one tiny attack. Underneath, it is a travel object: two ANA domestic boarding-pass stubs, a postcard, a Media Factory deadline, and the phrase ANA special 2000 version card holding the route on the cardboard. The card asks the agent to be gentle and strict at the same time.
